title: feat(backend): complete layered architecture, 46 database models, schemas, and API routers
author: SmartCity360 Architecture Team
problem: SmartCity360 requires a comprehensive, production-grade backend engine spanning all 26 municipal domains with zero paid API dependencies.
solution: Constructed layered FastAPI application with SQLAlchemy 2.0 async models (46 tables), Pydantic v2 schemas, Argon2/Bcrypt direct hashing, generic repository patterns, state-machine business services, REST API v1 endpoints, database seed dataset, and complete automated pytest suite.
security_considerations: Direct bcrypt hashing with 12 rounds, JWT access tokens, correlation ID middleware, strict security headers, and rate limiting.
